name: serif-readtime-font-control
description: A "minutes to read" block and an accessible floating reading-controls widget (text size, line height, contrast) that remembers the reader's choices.

scripts.makepot: wp-env run cli --env-cwd=/var/www/html/wp-content/plugins/serif-readtime-font-control wp i18n make-pot . languages/serif-readtime-font-control.pot --domain=serif-readtime-font-control --exclude=node_modules,vendor,tests,build,scripts
scripts.update-po: wp-env run cli --env-cwd=/var/www/html/wp-content/plugins/serif-readtime-font-control wp i18n update-po languages/serif-readtime-font-control.pot languages/
scripts.makemo: wp-env run cli --env-cwd=/var/www/html/wp-content/plugins/serif-readtime-font-control wp i18n make-mo languages/
scripts.makejson: wp-env run cli --env-cwd=/var/www/html/wp-content/plugins/serif-readtime-font-control wp i18n make-json languages/ --no-purge --pretty-print
